evidence_quotes.agenda: before I go over with our pricing structure and your estimate, do you have any specific concern or stresser about the moving process in general?
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: No. — no concern was raised at the agenda ask, so full credit applies (N/A rule); a real budget objection surfaced later during pricing and is graded separately under Save Your Ass/close
evidence_quotes.save_your_ass: Does that make sense so far?

top_strength: Managed a genuinely complex multi-stop move (home to storage unit plus a drop-off at the customer's mother's house) cleanly, keeping every location and item straight.
coaching_note: When the customer pushed back hard on price at the end, there was no Save Your Ass reframing or value reinforcement ready — just repeated acknowledgments and a cheaper weekday rate — and the call was lost with no close attempt at all.
